architecture_summary: Modular React app. Design system components extracted from Stitch screens. Pages map 1:1 to major Stitch screens. Shared UI kit in src/components/. Router use React Router. State minimal, local-first. CSS-in-JS via Emotion (already in Stitch output). No Redux (YAGNI).

tickets.title: Extract design system components from Stitch screens
tickets.description: Pull button, badge, card, input, loader/skeleton, tab, table, toast/alert from respective Stitch design system screens. Build atomic components in src/components/ui/. Use exact Stitch class names for CSS. Keep props minimal (children, variant, disabled, onClick). No custom hooks. No state. No logic. Pure presentational.
acceptance_criteria: All variants (primary, secondary, danger, etc.) work
Storybook stories auto-generated (ponytail: skip now, add when design system docs needed)

tickets.title: Build showcase_playful_bento page
tickets.description: Convert Stitch bento grid to React page. Use design system components. Layout via CSS Grid. Responsive. No hardcoded colors (use design tokens from src/theme.js). No business logic. Static data for now. Route: /.
acceptance_criteria: All interactive elements (buttons, tabs) clickable but noop

tickets.title: Build feature_highlights_kids_learning_platform page
tickets.description: Convert feature highlights carousel to React. Use Card, Button components. Static data. Route: /features.

tickets.title: Build 404 error pages (mystery_puzzle, jungle_trail, cosmic_detour)
tickets.description: Convert three 404 designs to React. Rotate randomly on 404. Use design system components. Route: /404.

tickets.title: Build theme and design tokens
tickets.description: Extract colors, spacing, typography from Stitch screens. Build theme.js. Use CSS variables. Apply globally. No hardcoded values in components.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Build app shell. Add navigation bar (match Stitch header). Set up React Router. Routes: /, /features, /404. 404 catch-all. Lazy load pages. No auth yet (YAGNI).
acceptance_criteria: Lazy loading (ponytail: skip error boundaries now, add when error reporting needed)
